fields.meta_description: Build a mortgage landing page from a prompt, with a short pre-approval form, a refinance check, and leads routed to the right loan officer.
fields.h1: Build a Mortgage Landing Page That Books the First Call
fields.hero_description: Build a mortgage landing page that asks four short questions and books each ready buyer onto a loan officer's calendar.
fields.features_heading: What Each Mortgage Lead Passes Through
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds six parts into a mortgage landing page: the questions a borrower answers and what happens to the lead next.
fields.feature_1:
A short form, one question per screen

Emergent builds the form as one question per screen, with tap-to-answer choices for loan purpose and credit range. A borrower on a phone finishes it before typing a name.
fields.feature_2:
Leads routed by state and loan type

Write the routing in plain English, such as "refinance leads in Indiana go to the refi team." The page sends each lead where that rule says and records which person received it.
fields.feature_3:
Every lead saved in a database you own

Each lead becomes a row in a database you own, with the answers, the ad that brought the borrower in, and the assigned loan officer. Filter those rows by week or by ad source.
fields.feature_4:
Synced to the CRM you already use

Connect the CRM or loan origination system that holds your pipeline, if it has an API. Each new lead arrives there with the borrower's answers, and nobody retypes a phone number.
fields.feature_5:
Alerts when a ready buyer comes in

Pick the leads that need a person fast, such as a buyer with an accepted offer. The page posts each one to a Slack channel or emails the assigned loan officer with the answers.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, and the code to take with you

Publish on the lender's own domain; custom domains are included and use credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository for developers to extend.

fields.tab_content_1:
Buyers with 60 days to close book a call today

Larkspur Lending's purchase page asks four questions, ending with when the buyer expects to close. Noor Haddadin entered a $385,000 home price, $38,500 down, and a close within 60 days. That answer offered her a same-day call on loan officer Tobiah Marchetti's calendar, and her answers saved to the leads table.
fields.tab_content_2:
Refinance leads up to 80% loan-to-value reach the team

A homeowner types two numbers into Thornbury Mortgage's refinance check: a home value of $410,000 and a balance of $287,000. The page works out the loan-to-value from those two. Every check saves to the leads table, and a lead with a loan-to-value up to 80% also posts to the refinance team's Slack channel.
fields.tab_content_3:
Each loan officer gets a page from the same prompt

Harbor Point Mortgage wrote one prompt and got a page for each of its 6 loan officers, with a photo, the NMLS ID, licensed states, and a call button. Imogen Szabo's page lists Ohio and Indiana. It saved 14 leads this month, and each one carries her name in the leads table.
fields.tab_content_4:
When the rate meets their target, 38 borrowers get an email

Wrenfield Home Loans keeps a rate watch list. Each subscriber picks a target rate for a 30-year fixed loan. This morning the loan officer posted the day's rate with its APR beside it, and the page emailed the 38 of 212 subscribers whose target was at least that rate. Each email shows both numbers.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Mortgage Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Seven steps take a mortgage landing page from one loan type to a published page that routes each lead to a loan officer.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Choose one loan type per page
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Write down what the first call needs
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Show any rate as an APR
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Describe the page in a prompt
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pick one loan type and one borrower for the page, such as first-time buyers looking for a purchase loan. A homeowner weighing a refinance answers different questions than a buyer does. Give each one its own page, with a headline written for that borrower.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List only what a loan officer needs before the first call: loan purpose, home price or value, down payment or balance, credit range, timeline, and contact details. Leave Social Security numbers and income documents for the full application, after that call.
fields.howto_step_3_des: If the page states a rate of finance charge, Regulation Z says to state it as an annual percentage rate. For credit secured by a dwelling, a simple annual rate may appear only alongside the APR, and not more conspicuously. Have compliance read every rate line.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste the fields and the routing into one prompt for Emergent, with the loan type in the first line. It returns a working page with the form and the leads table behind it. Ask for the thank-you screen in the same prompt, including when the borrower will hear back.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Route leads by the state a loan officer is licensed in, by loan type, or by a single answer, such as a VA loan. Then choose which leads post to a Slack channel and which go by email to one loan officer.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Put the NMLS ID in the footer
fields.howto_step_6_des: Add the company's NMLS ID and each loan officer's to the footer, with the states they are licensed in. NMLS Consumer Access is a free service for consumers to confirm that the company or professional they want to work with is authorized in their state.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Submit a test lead from your phone and follow it through: the row in the leads table, the calendar booking, the Slack post, and the CRM record. Publish once every step works, and give each ad campaign its own source tag.

faq_plan.q: What is a mortgage landing page?
faq_plan.a: A mortgage landing page is a standalone page built for one loan offer, such as a purchase pre-approval or a refinance check. Its short form turns a visitor into a lead, and it leaves out the lender's full site menu and hands every lead to a loan officer for the first call.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a mortgage landing page?
faq_plan.a: Describe it to Emergent's AI landing page builder in a few sentences: the loan type, the questions to ask, and who should get each lead. Emergent builds the page and a table for its leads. Read the first version on a phone, the way a borrower would, before you publish it.

faq_plan.q: Should mortgage landing pages ask for a credit score?
faq_plan.a: No. Ask for a self-reported credit range instead, such as 720 to 759, offered as tap-to-answer choices. A borrower can answer that without pulling a report, and the loan officer still knows which programs to raise on the call. The exact score comes later, when the borrower applies and agrees to a credit check.

faq_plan.q: Are mortgage landing page templates worth starting from?
faq_plan.a: Yes for the layout, less so for the rest. A template fixes the sections, but the questions, the routing, and the follow-up decide whether a lead becomes a call, and a prompt can set all three at once. If the page should be found in search as well as through ads, read up on landing page seo before you write the headline.

faq_plan.q: What should loan officer landing pages include?
faq_plan.a: Each one needs the officer's name and photo, the NMLS ID, the states where they hold a license, and one way to reach them, such as a call button or a calendar. Tag every lead with the officer's name. Each officer can then see what their own page brings in, apart from the company's other pages.

faq_plan.q: Can a mortgage landing page show a monthly payment?
faq_plan.a: Yes, but under Regulation Z the amount of any payment is a triggering term, and an ad that states one must meet the disclosure requirements in paragraph (d)(2). A down payment amount or percentage, the number of payments or period of repayment, and a finance charge trigger them too. Have compliance review the page before it goes live.

faq_plan.q: How do I add a rate watch signup to a mortgage landing page?
faq_plan.a: Add a short signup with an email and a target rate, and have the page email each borrower when the posted rate meets that target. It works like a waitlist landing page with one extra field. Ask for the loan type as well, because a refinance target and a purchase target belong on different lists.

faq_plan.q: How does a mortgage landing page send leads to the right loan officer?
faq_plan.a: It follows routing rules you set. Match the borrower's state to the states each loan officer is licensed in, then rotate leads in turn among the officers left. Send any lead with no match to one named person instead of a shared inbox. On Emergent, each rule is a sentence in the prompt, and changing one means prompting again.

faq_plan.q: How should a mortgage landing page handle borrower data?
faq_plan.a: Collect only what the first call needs and keep it in one place. Each lead is stored in a database you own, and Emergent has SOC 2 Type I and ISO 27001. Before launch, delete the test leads you submitted, and decide who on the team can open the leads table.

faq_plan.q: Should each ad point to a different mortgage landing page?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Send a refinance ad to the refinance page and a first-time buyer ad to the purchase page. Treat each one like any ppc landing page: one offer and one form, under a headline that repeats the ad's own words.

plan.angle: Searches for this keyword and its secondaries (mortgage landing pages, templates, loan officer pages) want examples and a fast way to publish one. Template galleries stop at the layout. This page shows four mortgage pages built from a prompt and follows each lead to where it lands: a purchase pre-approval request booked onto a loan officer's calendar, a refinance check that works out loan-to-value, a personal page for each loan officer with the NMLS ID, and a rate watch list that emails a borrower when the posted rate reaches their target. The FAQ covers the definition, form length, credit questions, how to show a rate next to its APR, routing, privacy and one page per ad. Insurance pages are a sibling and stay out.
